item.title: 🟠 Unpatched Argo CD Repo-Server Flaw Could Let Attackers Take Over Kubernetes Clusters
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.

item.title: 🔵 Microsoft Removes 119 Edge Extensions That Hid Malware in Images and Fonts
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
Microsoft has shut down a long-running malicious extension operation on the Edge Add-ons store that hid its payloads inside ordinary image and font files, then woke up days after install to steal credentials and run ad fraud. The company calls it StegoAd, a mash-up of steganography and adware, and ties 119 extensions to a single threat actor it says has been active since at least 2021.

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: FYI  |  Age: 2d ago
